_comment: Licence texts for bundled Python packages whose wheels ship none. A "text" is the project's LICENSE file, fetched from the source repository named here; a "note" is used instead where the licence is a vendor agreement published only on the web. scripts/build_notices.py fails the build for any bundled package that has neither its own licence file nor an entry here.

cuda-toolkit.note: Redistributed under the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit End User License Agreement, https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/eula/index.html. Bundled only in builds made with --torch cuda.

nvidia-cusparselt-cu13.note: Redistributed under the NVIDIA cuSPARSELt license agreement, https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cusparselt/license.html. Bundled only in builds made with --torch cuda.
